panels.title: 📡 Telemetria de Campo (Dados Brutos ESP32 / Simulador)
Temperaturas de Interface (Lado Quente vs Frio)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "teg_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "t_quente" or r["_field"] == "t_frio")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "teg_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "potencia_mW")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "teg_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "teg_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "eficiencia_relativa")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "teg_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "teg_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "score_degradacao")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value < 0.15 then "SAUDÁVEL" else if r._value < 0.35 then "ALERTA" else "CRÍTICO" }))
  |> last()

from(bucket: "teg_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "teg_analytics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "r_int_medida")
  |> last()

panels.title: Comparativo em Tempo Real: Tensão Real (ESP) vs Tensão Teórica (Gêmeo Digital)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "teg_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer" and r["_field"] == "tensao_V") or (r["_measurement"] == "teg_analytics" and r["_field"] == "v_ideal"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
